summaries.Romania: Romania faces budget pressures and political instability as the government warns of potential rating downgrades without credible fiscal plans, while judicial independence concerns mount following sanctions against judges who convicted a former minister. Key economic challenges include energy costs, PNRR fund absorption delays, and mounting insolvencies across the private sector.
summaries.Healthcare: Gene therapy safety concerns escalated as Novartis disclosed previously unreported tumor cases in Zolgensma-treated children, while healthcare systems grapple with Medicare payment cuts and the transition toward value-based care models. Policy shifts under new administrations are reshaping reimbursement, prior authorization, and AI integration in clinical settings.
summaries.Tech: Apple completed its major hardware launch cycle with touchscreen MacBooks, foldable iPhones, and new AI features rolling out, while broader tech industry faces regulatory scrutiny on AI expansion, data privacy, and surveillance. Major acquisitions (Fox-Roku, potential NYT-Letterboxd) signal consolidation, and cybersecurity threats from industrial hacks and election interference continue escalating.

items.title: STAT+: Novartis cites cases of previously unknown tumors possibly tied to its SMA gene therapy

items.title: What Democratic control of Congress means for healthcare in 2027
